purpose: Defines the equilibrium constant K for the (desulfurization-type) exchange reaction between melt and slag in terms of the activities of oxygen and sulfur in the melt and in the slag.

symbols.meaning: activity of oxygen in the melt
activity of sulfur in the slag
activity of sulfur in the melt
activity of oxygen in the slag
